Container.Name: Find My Timeline
Container.Overview: Private, self-hosted location history for Apple Find My devices. Find My Timeline stores positions locally in SQLite and presents routes, timestamps, battery levels and a chronological timeline in a responsive WebUI. Includes persistent Unraid appdata, Docker health checks and guided Apple two-factor authentication.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: Apple Find My location history timeline iCloud tracking map GPS responsive dashboard mobile self-hosted
Container.Requires: Apple ID with two-factor authentication, internet access and persistent appdata storage. Complete initial authentication in the guided WebUI. Location history is sensitive: keep the WebUI on a trusted LAN or access it through a VPN or authenticated HTTPS reverse proxy. Do not expose it directly to the internet.
Container.Changes: Version 0.4.5 adds privacy-safe aggregate polling logs. The Community Applications listing now uses cache-safe PNG screenshots and streamlined installation guidance.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Host port used to open the responsive Find My Timeline WebUI. Keep this port limited to your trusted network and do not expose it directly to the internet.

Config.Name: Database
Config.Description: Persistent directory for the SQLite database containing device and location history. Include this directory in protected backups.

Config.Name: Apple Session
Config.Description: Stores reusable Apple session cookies and authentication metadata. Keep this mapping enabled during updates and include it in protected backups.

Config.Name: Disable WebUI authentication flow
Config.Description: Leave false to use guided Apple re-authentication. Set true only when browser authentication must be explicitly unavailable.

Config.Name: WebUI administrator password
Config.Description: Optional environment-managed password. Leave empty to create a persistent hashed administrator password through guided first-run setup.

Config.Name: Estimated session lifetime
Config.Description: Estimated Apple session lifetime in days used by the status countdown. Apple can invalidate a session earlier.

Config.Name: Authentication flow timeout
Config.Description: Maximum number of seconds allowed between starting Apple authentication and entering the verification code.

Config.Name: Minimum polling interval
Config.Description: Minimum number of minutes between Apple location requests. Use a value no greater than the maximum interval.

Config.Name: Maximum polling interval
Config.Description: Maximum number of minutes between Apple location requests. Must be equal to or greater than the minimum interval.

Config.Name: Authentication retry interval
Config.Description: Minutes to wait before retrying after Apple authentication or polling failures. Successful WebUI re-authentication triggers an immediate retry.

Config.Name: Database path
Config.Description: Database file path inside the container. Change only when using a custom persistent data layout.

Config.Name: Web host
Config.Description: Internal web server binding. Keep 0.0.0.0 when using the standard Unraid bridge network.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Internal container port for the WebUI. Normally this should remain 5000.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone used for container logs and displayed timestamps, for example Europe/Berlin.
